understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by getting every selectable piece onto the goal tiles marked with '+' at the same time; a level only reports WIN when all '+' tiles are simultaneously occupied by selectable pieces, and finishing all levels wins the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement was turn-based with a limited step budget per level. Directional MOVE actions moved the currently selected piece one grid step unless blocked by walls/obstacles; pushing was only possible when the adjacent cell contained a movable object and the cell beyond it was empty, otherwise the move was blocked. CLICK selected and/or attempted to move the selected piece directly to a clicked coordinate only when the game rules allowed (e.g., switching between selectable pieces or valid target squares); clicking invalid/blocked positions had no effect and still consumed steps.
